$comment: Subject Vocabulary Standard 0.9, a pre-release for testing before 1.0. SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. Copyright 2026 Jamie Clayton. 0.x versions may still change within their folder; from 1.0, released versions are immutable and changes ship as a new major.minor folder. Rules that JSON Schema cannot express (SV001 onwards) are defined in the specification and checked by conformance tooling.
title: Subject vocabulary adoption register
description: A repository's docs/registers/subject-vocabulary.json: which release of the core scheme it pins, and whether it extends that scheme or replaces it with a private set (core), the local prefixes it uses, its own concepts and components, extra suggester hints, and a map from the tag strings it used before adopting. A register never redefines a core concept: ability: always means the core scheme. Envelope keys are Dublin Core terms and concept keys are SKOS terms; see context.jsonld.

$schema.description: The released version of this standard the register pins (dcterms:conformsTo). Must name a major.minor folder; there is no floating version.

description.description: What the register adds and why (dcterms:description).

identifier.description: Persistent identifier of the register, as a URI such as an ARK (dcterms:identifier).

publisher.description: The repository or organisation publishing the register (dcterms:publisher).

created.description: When the register was first created (dcterms:created).

version.description: The register's own semantic version (dcterms:hasVersion), independent of the standard version in $schema.

source.description: The vocabulary this one was derived from (dcterms:source).

language.description: BCP 47 language tag for labels and definitions (dcterms:language).

coverage.description: Which documents the register applies to: a repository, or path globs within one (dcterms:coverage).

rights.description: Licence of the register, ideally an SPDX identifier (dcterms:rights).

core.description: extend (the default when absent): the core scheme's concepts plus this register's. replace: this register's concepts only; ability: notations then do not resolve here. Changing it is a major change of the register's version.

prefixes.description: The local scheme prefixes this register opts into resolution. Absent means theme and component. ability is reserved for the core scheme and can never be declared.

conceptBase.description: IRI base for this repository's local concepts; a concept's IRI is conceptBase + prefix + / + name. Two repositories may use the same local notation for different things, so local concepts are only ever compared within one repository.

concepts.description: Local concepts. One with no broader is a top concept; any declared prefix may hold top concepts.

hints.description: Extra suggester hints for concepts, keyed by notation. Additive only: a hint never changes a concept's labels or definition.

components.description: Code areas of this repository, matched by path globs relative to the repository root. A document that mentions a component's path counts toward the component's broader concept.

items.description: A component is a concept (any concept key, prefLabel optional) with the path patterns that identify it.

legacy.description: Tag strings the repository used before adopting, each mapped to the concept that replaces it. Read by the suggester; the tag strings stay valid in documents.

retired.description: Local concepts no longer offered, each naming its replacement.

localConcept.$comment: Shapes come from conceptBody; the true entries only declare which keys are required here. definition is recommended, not required, for a local concept.
